correctness.rationale: Exact conditional deletion identity follows by summing missing-species indicators. Fixed finite multinomial entropy expansion is independently derived from binomial central moments, with exponential tail control, and agrees with the published expansion. Minimum-probability entropy deletion gap is strictly positive by Shannon chain rule and the entropy bound log(s-1). Nonminimal absence probabilities are exponentially smaller. The packaged checker verifies 180 exact rational coefficients of logarithms; these finite tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Ecological samples routinely report richness and Shannon index together. Their joint sampling covariance is not obtainable from separate marginal error bars. The theorem gives an exact computable finite-sample formula and a sharp exponential decay constant in terms of the rarest taxa, including universal first and explicit second correction; this identifies the scale governing near-saturation joint uncertainty. Limited to fixed IID communities; no inferential or field-data claims.
